request: Owner: «убери эту странную тему с посадочным и прогресс-линиями в виде самолётов, местами добавляй итальянские пейзажи, сделанные в Higgsfield, на фон», for the home scenes «вписать информацию красивее с фото пейзажа на фоне», then «Веспи можно для смеха вписать непосредственно в пейзажи».
model: gpt_image_2_5 (Higgsfield), variant flare, quality high, 1k, 3:2. Shipped scenes were regenerated with the mascot's reference images (image_references ab833075-dfc7-4e28-824c-7e299aad556c, a448f972-9035-4be6-b0ca-1f0f7800f1a5) so Vespi stands inside each place; the Tuscan scene additionally upscaled to 2k (bytedance_image_upscale) for the cabinet hero
promptTemplate: Editorial travel photograph, 35mm, photorealistic: [one place]. The exact same handmade cotton toy character as in the references (smooth cream cotton body, satin red helmet with a cream stripe, tiny dot eyes, olive green felt collar with a red button) [pose] in the lower left third of the frame, small in the scene, clearly a soft toy placed in the real place. No text, no signs, no flags, no other people, no logos.
processing: Downloaded inside the Higgsfield sandbox, saved as 1024×688 JPEG q82 masters (sha256 below, byte-identical copies brought over), exported here as WebP q76/q78 at 640 and 1024px with sharp into public/illustrations/landscapes (tuscany also at 1600px from the upscale). Reviewed at full size: no people, text, signs, flags or logos; one Vespi per scene, lower left. Pages crop the photos towards the left (object-position 18–30%) so Vespi stays in frame. The first, mascot-free versions (jobs listed under plainScenes) were reviewed and shipped briefly, then replaced; amalfi and padua were generated and are not shipped (padua's arcade frieze carries painted medallions).
